control_meaning: Two valid schema-neutral YAML 1.2 documents; expected typed trees are hand-written in controls/yaml/check_controls.py and cross-checked with Ruby Psych/libyaml.

third_party.scope: load(text) with the default CORE_SCHEMA after strict UTF-8 decoding of a local Buffer; YAMLException rejects the input; the returned value is mapped to the Parsarium typed YAML tree

parseDocument(text) with default options (YAML 1.2 core schema) after strict UTF-8 decoding of a local Buffer; zero errors and warnings required; Document.toJS() mapped to the Parsarium typed YAML tree

load(text) after strict UTF-8 decoding of a local Buffer; zero errors on the returned root node required; the documented AST (YamlMap.mappings, YAMLSequence.items, YAMLAnchorReference.value, YAMLScalar.value typed by determineScalarType with parseYamlBoolean/parseYamlInteger/parseYamlFloat) mapped to the Parsarium typed YAML tree
parseWithPointers(text) with default options after strict UTF-8 decoding of a local Buffer; zero diagnostics required; the returned data mapped to the Parsarium typed YAML tree
parseYAML(text) after strict UTF-8 decoding of a local Buffer; a ParseError or more than one document rejects the input; getStaticYAMLValue(ast) mapped to the Parsarium typed YAML tree
load(text) after strict UTF-8 decoding of a local Buffer; a YAMLError rejects the input; the constructed value is mapped to the Parsarium typed YAML tree

default export yamlToMomoa(yaml) after strict UTF-8 decoding of a local Buffer; a thrown yaml error (including more than one document) or empty contents rejects the input; the returned Momoa Document body mapped to the Parsarium typed YAML tree

parse(text) with default options (YAML 1.2, core schema, strict) after strict UTF-8 decoding of a local Buffer; a YAMLError rejects the input; the returned value is mapped to the Parsarium typed YAML tree
parseDocument(text) with default options after strict UTF-8 decoding of a local Buffer; zero errors and warnings required; Document.toJS() mapped to the Parsarium typed YAML tree
parse(source) with default options after strict UTF-8 decoding of a local Buffer; a thrown YamlError rejects the input; the returned plain values are mapped to the Parsarium typed YAML tree
